meta.name: error-personality
meta.description: How the AI communicates mistakes, uncertainty, and limitations gracefully.

copy.tagline: 让AI优雅地表达错误和不确定性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI在出错时表达得更自然得体
copy.tagline_en: Make AI communicate mistakes and uncertainty gracefully
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI to express errors and uncertainty in a natural and polite way

howto.what: Claude 在出错时会根据错误严重程度采取不同回应：轻微错误快速修正，重大错误清晰道歉并提供正确版本，同时避免过度道歉或推诿。
howto.when: 当 Claude 回答事实错误、误解用户意图、无法完成任务、语气不当、输出不完整或产生幻觉时触发。

say.text: 你刚才说的数据有误，请修正。
say.note: Claude 会直接承认错误并提供正确版本。

say.text: 这个任务你做不到，有没有替代方案？
say.note: Claude 会将限制转化为替代路径。

howto.what_en: Claude adapts error responses by severity: quick fix for minor errors, clear acknowledgment with corrected output for major errors, avoiding over-apologizing or deflection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude makes factual errors, misunderstands, cannot complete task, mismatches tone, delivers incomplete output, or hallucinates.

say_en.text: You gave wrong data earlier. Please correct it.
say_en.note: Claude will directly admit the mistake and provide a corrected version.

say_en.text: Can you suggest an alternative if you can't do this?
say_en.note: Claude turns a limitation into an alternative path.
